resources.string: Compose accents in informal spellings, loanwords and some names. Choose individual letters below.
Some English words with Vietnamese rhymes gain accents: fast → fát when f is enabled. Repeat the tone key to keep English: fasst → fast.
Advanced Telex still uses initial w for ư (wa → ưa). Type ww for consonant w: wwas → wá.
